metadata.description: NextWork's open-source video plugins: measure how a short-form creator edits, then edit your own talking-head video in that style.

plugins.name: creator-teardown
plugins.description: Break down any short-form creator's videos: view counts, word-level transcripts, measured pace, cuts, zooms and caption style.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: New videos with no footage of your own: a fully animated video from a text prompt (a script in scenes, an animation per scene, and any of an AI voiceover, on-screen text and music), and the best moments of long streams and gameplay videos as short clips with a facecam layout, captions, a cover image and a post caption; a long researched video from one prompt with found footage, pictures and graphics; UGC-style ads cut from filmed clips with different hooks; and subtitle files in other languages for any finished video. Uses the ai-editor plugin's animation, sound, transcription and renderer.

plugins.name: ai-editor
plugins.description: Edit your own talking-head video in a creator's measured style: retakes and pauses cut, then zooms, captions and cards rendered with Remotion on your laptop or AWS Lambda.
